title: ‘Red Eye’ Star Jing Lusi on the “Perfect Binge-Fest” That Is Season 2 — And Why She’s Still Waiting for the U.K.’s ‘Crazy Rich Asians’ Moment
summary: The Brit returns to the role of the formidable Hana Li in the ITV thriller — backdropped by the U.S. Embassy in season two — and is getting candid about becoming a leading lady: "As someone who's played quite a few wives and girlfriends, it's nice to be able to stand on your own."
